snippet.title: Tony The Mole | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play as Tony, a curious little mole with a serious digging habit, a taste for worms, and a dream of reaching the surface. Help townsfolk, repair gadgets, collect delightful hats, and explore hidden spaces as you uncover the story of Pebblegrove.

Whishlist Tony The Mole on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562370/Tony_The_Mole/

Follow us: https://linktr.ee/lucktape_games

Tony the Mole is a short cozy underground adventure where you play as a curious little mole with dreams of reaching the surface. Raised by humans in the town of Pebblegrove, Tony sets out on a journey to uncover the town’s secrets, help its quirky residents, and dig his way toward the world above.
